title: Library update pointer (latest.json)
description: Generated by tools/make_manifest.py. Lives at the root of the public content repository and points to an immutable content commit. Verification chain: latest.json -> index (indexSha256) -> lessons (entry sha256).

publishedAt.description: Equals the referenced index's generatedAt (the release timestamp).

contentCommit.description: Full Git commit SHA containing the index and every lesson it lists. Never a branch name.

indexPath.description: Path of the index relative to the repository root at contentCommit. Entry file paths are relative to the index's folder.

indexSha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact index bytes at contentCommit.
